realReviews.author: Susette Clark-Walker
realReviews.text: We had an amazing experience working with Larry! He helped us update and refresh our home, and the results were beyond what we imagined. He painted both the interior and exterior beautifully — the attention to detail really shows. He also installed new cabinets, cabinet doors, and drawers, as well as updated the lighting throughout the house. Everything was completed with care, professionalism, and high-quality craftsmanship. He was reliable, easy to communicate with, and truly went above and beyond to make sure we were happy with every detail. We highly recommend Larry to anyone looking for a skilled and trustworthy building professional!

realReviews.author: Josh Luebbers
realReviews.text: Mr. Larry was easy to communicate with and did excellent work on our home. I had him pressure wash and repair/renew our fascia and soffits by caulking and painting around the whole house. The results were better than expected and it was a pleasure working with The Maintenance Man! I'll be contacting him again for future projects.

realReviews.author: Elisabeth Palchak
realReviews.text: A good, reliable handyman is hard to find. The Google reviews for Larry are accurate. Larry and his team were great at communicating, professional, punctual, knowledgeable, and displayed great attention to detail. They did mud work, painted my kitchen, repaired outdoor rot, and replaced & fixed doors. Larry is honest and fair priced--I highly recommend!

finalCta.headline: Got a paint job or repair that's been waiting?
finalCta.body: Send a few details and photos, or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just an honest conversation about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form with a few photos, or call. Larry looks at it and gives you a price and time frame before any work starts.
Hattiesburg and the surrounding area, including West Hattiesburg, Petal, Glendale, Rawls Springs, Arnold Line and Palmers Crossing. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. A single door, a few rotten boards or one room of paint gets the same care as a whole-house project.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time to look at the job.
